scenes.title: Bonilla Semiconductor Probe Workstation
scenes.reference_notes: Inspected the official probe-contact close-up and narrow equipment collage. The close-up supports a compact metal platen, brass rod holders and fine angled probe tips; it does not establish full laboratory dimensions. This scene reconstructs that local apparatus on an authored compact bench, with generic readout electronics. In-house, shared cleanroom and shared electron-microscopy inventories are separate; no shared cleanroom tools are placed in this scene.
observed_cues: Metal platen with visible corner bolts and small specimen contact region.
Opposed brass/metal shafts and dark angled fine contact probes.
Official inventory distinguishes in-house electrical characterization from shared cleanroom and electron microscopy.

equipment.role: Coarse sample translation and two independently actuated probe approach surrogates over an inert 12 mm coupon
equipment.evidence: Original geometry based on official local-apparatus photograph; hidden mechanics and scale estimated

task.name: Position an inert semiconductor coupon and inspect probes
task.description: Translate the visible coupon carrier and adjust two probe clearance positions. The tips remain above the sample and no electrical measurement or contact-force outcome is generated.
task.observable: Three mechanical axes track bounded targets; the inert sample stays clamped on the supported platen.

layout_rationale: Only workstation evidence is available; the surrounding room, shelf, readout enclosure and storage counter are authored context.
The compact probe fixture has four supporting feet seated on a separate steel bench; sample carrier and probe holders connect to the platen.
Fine tip geometry and small inert coupon retain a plausible device scale; no photographs are mapped onto the specimen or surfaces.
The clear front approach and lateral instrument space are layout choices, not a recovered Oxford room plan.
limitations: Reference-informed prototype, not surveyed or institution-validated. No endorsement, institutional review or original-media redistribution permission has been established.
The source image has no dimensional scale, manufacturer identification or documented motorized control contract; all axes are mechanical surrogates.
Probe tips remain in a clearance pose. Contact-force physics, current-voltage response, impedance, semiconductor transport and calibrated measurement are absent.
Only the local probe setup is modeled; the full in-house, cleanroom and shared microscopy inventories are not reproduced.
MuJoCo CPU mechanical controls can be checked; USD/GLB/Blender are visual snapshots without validated Isaac dynamics.

reference_detail_evidence.dimension_confidence: Undimensioned close-up; all room and apparatus dimensions estimated
reference_detail_evidence.rights: Original authored geometry, no source photographs redistributed
